summary: Phase 1 adversarial re-audit at 54213a00: PASS. Red's fix closes all four routed findings and survives every probe. The full regression gate (bash measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/adversarial-p1.sh) exits 0 with the control OK and all nine probes CAUGHT, including the three gate probes that passed fabricated data at feeca3f3: the fabricated MAPS rating 9.9 and note now fail, the claude-family maker now fails, and the absent-source inn row now fails on the state cell, not on a note substring. The real tree still passes the fixed checker (exit 0, PASS=9 FAIL=0). Five new probes against the value checks behave correctly: a one-word note drift is caught, an emptied note cell is caught, a rating of 7.00 is accepted because the rating is enforced as a number equal to the recorded value (judged not a defect; 9.9, 6.5, and non-numeric cells fail), a slug cell with a trailing space is accepted because cell parses trim surrounding whitespace by the checker's own normalization (judged not a defect; the trimmed value must still equal the TSV slug, and probe 06 shows a real slug drift fails), and a correctly labeled missing row now passes the gate as ADV-4 designed while its mislabeled variant still fails. The embedded expected-values table was verified against the final bench/sonnet/log.tsv rows for all 30 civic P2 slugs: 30 of 30 equal. One Nit stays open: the expected values are pinned inside the checker, so a later edit of bench/sonnet/log.tsv would not be caught by the gate.
